payment_plan.quote: will allow for at least 30 days past the payment due date before pursuing collections

notes: Policy includes separate sections for Colorado, Kansas, and Utah with different FPL thresholds and copay structures. Emergency care is treated regardless of ability to pay or coverage status. Patients must be screened for financial assistance when possible. The policy references compliance with PPACA, Internal Revenue Code Section 501(r), and Colorado Senate Bill 14-50. Copayment minimums are noted for insured and uninsured patients in each state.

dropped.quote: The legislation requires hospitals to provide financial assistance to patients in emergent situations and whose incomes are less than 250 percent of the current year’s federal poverty level.
dropped.why: Policy restricts financial assistance to Colorado residents in emergent situations with income ≤250% FPL, not any of the four conditions.
